title: Backlog Artifact Audience + Register
description: The controlled vocabulary for the AUDIENCE of a backlog artifact — the required input the orchestrator supplies to the project-manager (never guessed). Two orthogonal dimensions: `audience` (who reads/acts on it) and, when a human reads it, `register` (their relationship to the work). The MATRIX semantics (how each audience changes the artifact; why business is a decider not merely 'less technical') live in the standard-backlog-artifacts skill. This file defines the value domains only. Reference a co-located consumer via {"$ref": "audience-register.schema.json#/$defs/rendered"}.

audience.description: Who will read/act on the artifact.

register.description: When a human reads it, their relationship to the work. Moot when audience is `agent`.

rendered.description: The composite audience+register token as written on an artifact and passed in a delegation.
